wt_villager: We were people once. Some days I still remember what it felt like. This is the Whispering Shore - a fishing village, when the murlocs let it be one.
wt_coldhearth_watcher: Pell. I watch Cold Hearth Manor, just south of this post. It housed the living once. Now it houses what's left of them - reapers in the gardens, the dead in the hall - and every night there are more.
wt_vale_ranger: Ranger Corvin Ashe. That's the Nightmare Vale behind me, to the south-east. Worgs, nightcrawlers, and something that's been leaving needles in the trees. Keep to the road unless you're here to help me thin it.
wt_shore_fisher: Quillon. I fish the Whispering Shore - or I did, until the Vile Fin murlocs took the strand, my nets and my boat. Nothing bites any more except them, and they bite with spears.
wt_outpost_scout: Dessa Vane, scout. Keep your voice down. The Scarlet Crusade has built an outpost just east of here, and it's filling up with fresh converts who can't wait to burn something.
wt_solliden_farmer: Marren. Solliden's widow - this was his farm. He's still in it, and so are the hands, and none of them know they're dead. The fields are all that's left, so I tend them.
wt_pond_hermit: Oswin. I came out to Stillwater Pond for the quiet. The pond, just south-east of my door, has opinions about that. Things in the silt. Singing, at night.
wt_agamand_envoy: Envoy Sorren. Brill sent me to ask the Agamand family politely to stop raising their own dead - that's their mills, just north of here. I asked politely. After me, Brill sends you.
wt_crypt_keeper: Halvard. I keep the Agamand family crypt, east of where I stand. The family's dead, every one, and they will not stay quiet about it.
wt_garren_warden: Warden Brask. Garren's Haunt - the fields to the north-east - has always had Rot Hide gnolls. Lately it has more of them, and something with one eye telling them what to do.
